meta.title: Prompt Assistance & Fast Acceleration
meta.description: Provides prompt enhancement, next-question suggestions, and OpenAI Fast acceleration, with per-session configuration of models, reasoning effort, and auxiliary Fast.

fast.label: Fast
fast.off: Fast is off. Enable Priority for this session and inheriting OpenAI subagents; provider support is required and additional charges may apply.
fast.on: Fast is on for this session and inheriting OpenAI subagents; additional charges may apply. Click to turn off.
fast.error: Could not change Fast. Try again.
fast.command: Read or set this session's OpenAI Fast; subagents inherit their parent until explicitly overridden (on / off / status).
fast.unsupported: Fast is only available for explicitly allowed OpenAI model routes.
fast.enabled: OpenAI Fast enabled for this session and inheriting subagents. Priority may incur additional charges.
fast.disabled: Fast disabled for this session and inheriting subagents. Subsequent requests keep provider defaults.
assist.command: Save prompt assistance preferences for this session.
assist.retired: The retired assist configuration entry is disabled. Use Prompt assist.
